searchText: > for block rewards you don’t need to worry because the inclusion rewards for the proposer are computed immediately and applied without any introspection of the total attesting balance But the response of https://ethereum.github.io/beacon-APIs/?urls.primaryName=dev#/Beacon/getBlockRewards contains an `attestations` field, so we still have to wait I don’t think so? The reward for the block proposer happens inside `process_attestation` which happens during `process_block`. It doesn’t change after the block is applied I see now that I misunderstood the endpoint's response. Thanks! https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/issues/301

excerpts.author: radekkapka
excerpts.content:
> for block rewards you don’t need to worry because the inclusion rewards for the proposer are computed immediately and applied without any introspection of the total attesting balance

But the response of https://ethereum.github.io/beacon-APIs/?urls.primaryName=dev#/Beacon/getBlockRewards contains an `attestations` field, so we still have to wait

excerpts.author: sproul
excerpts.content: I don’t think so? The reward for the block proposer happens inside `process_attestation` which happens during `process_block`. It doesn’t change after the block is applied

excerpts.author: radekkapka
excerpts.content: I see now that I misunderstood the endpoint's response. Thanks!
